from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

im = Image.open('chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
px = im.load()

WHITE = {0x2654:'K',0x2655:'Q',0x2656:'R',0x2657:'B',0x2658:'N',0x2659:'P'}
BLACK = {0x265A:'k',0x265B:'q',0x265C:'r',0x265D:'b',0x265E:'n',0x265F:'p'}

def mask_from_square(r,c,kind):
    w=h=80
    m=Image.new('L',(w,h),0); mp=m.load()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            R,G,B=px[c*80+x, r*80+y]
            if kind=='black':
                v = 255 if (max(R,G,B)<80) else 0
            else:
                v = 255 if (min(R,G,B)>245) else 0
            mp[x,y]=v
    return m

def bbox_crop(m):
    bb=m.getbbox()
    if not bb: return None,None
    return m.crop(bb), bb

def norm(m, size=64):
    return m.resize((size,size), Image.NEAREST)

def render_ref(ch, kind, font_path, size):
    font=ImageFont.truetype(font_path,size)
    img=Image.new('L',(size*3,size*3),0)
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    # draw with white=255 ; for both, mask is glyph
    d.text((size,size),ch,fill=255,font=font,anchor='lt')
    bb=img.getbbox()
    if not bb: return None
    g=img.crop(bb)
    return g, (bb[2]-bb[0], bb[3]-bb[1])

def iou(a,b):
    a=norm(a); b=norm(b)
    pa=a.load(); pb=b.load(); inter=uni=0
    for y in range(64):
        for x in range(64):
            A=pa[x,y]>127; B=pb[x,y]>127
            if A or B: uni+=1
            if A and B: inter+=1
    return inter/uni if uni else 0

fonts=['/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf','/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSerif.ttf','/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSansMono.ttf']
sizes=[40,44,48,52,56,60,64,68,72]

occ=[]
for r in range(8):
    for c in range(8):
        mb=mask_from_square(r,c,'black'); mw=mask_from_square(r,c,'white')
        nb=sum(mb.getdata()); nw=sum(mw.getdata())
        if nb//255>50 or nw//255>50:
            occ.append((r,c,'black' if nb>nw else 'white', nb//255, nw//255))
print("occupied:",len(occ))
for r,c,kind,nb,nw in occ:
    m = mask_from_square(r,c,kind)
    g,bb=bbox_crop(m)
    ar = (bb[2]-bb[0])/(bb[3]-bb[1])
    best=(-1,None,None)
    for fp in fonts:
        chars = BLACK if kind=='black' else WHITE
        for code,name in chars.items():
            ch=chr(code)
            for s in sizes:
                res=render_ref(ch,kind,fp,s)
                if res is None: continue
                rg,rbb=res
                rar=(rbb[0])/(rbb[1])
                score=iou(g,rg)
                # penalize aspect mismatch slightly
                score2=score - 0.15*abs(ar-rar)
                if score2>best[0]:
                    best=(score2,name,fp.split('/')[-1]+f"@{s}",score,round(ar,2),round(rar,2),bb[2]-bb[0],bb[3]-bb[1])
    print(f"r{r}c{c} {kind:5s} n={nb if kind=='black' else nw:4d} bbox={bb[2]-bb[0]}x{bb[3]-bb[1]} ar={ar:.2f} best={best[1]} {best[2]} score={best[3]:.3f} s2={best[0]:.3f} rar={best[5]}")
